rv.q: If you do know The Cherry Orchard, you’ll be delighted by the way Stone has molded Chekhov’s characters.
] The still-lovely matriarch returning home from years abroad, coolly portrayed by award-winning South Korean star Jeon Do-yeon, remains an irresponsible, self-centered romantic.
The present-day setting is what ultimately makes this Cherry Orchard so tragic.

cn.t: Simon Stone's inventive Korean-language adaptation of Chekhov's classic wins praise for its fresh, funny take on the material, successfully transplanting the story to contemporary South Korea with bold theatricality.
